title: Dino's PVP pack
description: In this texturepack you'll see some things changed for PVP that Dino pro 910 uses on ze's videos
body:
In this texturepack you'll see some things changed for PVP that Dino pro 910 uses on ze's videos!

Items changed:

* Mace

* Netherite Sword

* Netherite Axe

* Cobweb

* Jack O' Lantern

* Enderpearl

* Totem Of Undying

* Golden Apples

* Carved Pumpkin

* Enviroment Clouds

* Secret Painting

* AND MUCH MORE!
